name: Yamaha CS3 / CS5 200
engine: 195 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, Autolube oil injection, electric start
intro: Yamaha's little two-stroke twins with electric start. Autolube, points and a five-speed box.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
